title: Cuban Rice & Beans with Garlicky Avocado, Tomato, Onion Salad

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans; set aside to drain further.
Trim, seed and small dice bell pepper. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, garlic, rice, and spices; cook, stirring constantly, until bell pepper is soft and rice is golden and toasted (you should hear a slight sizzle and pop from the rice), about 3 minutes.

Add beans, broth, and water to the pot, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir, cover, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the citrus into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the citrus juice along with oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Cut tomatoes into wedges and add to the bowl with the onions.
Halve and pit the avocados. Scoop halves out with a spoon and cut into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice and beans between plates; use a slotted spoon to portion salad, then drizzle leftover dressing over the rice and beans. Enjoy!
